body:
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 02:25Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #508, message a119ae7c), verbatim: „Usuniecie content-v1 to follow up a nie warunek konieczny.” Asistant: write it down and apply it; removing content-v1 does not block delivery of Unified EO and is done as a follow-up.
Applied (Fable): Unified EO is delivered when E3(b) is installed, TermAl's M1, w-24a7 and w-8f4c run after the joint restart, E2 increment 1 has landed and the w-e072 live proof has passed. E3(c) legacy and content-v1/watcher retirement, TermAl's w-6f42 content-v1 deletion step and E2 increment 2 are follow-ups that don't gate EO; they become independent items rather than required children of the EO parents.
